breakdown.description: It uses a = 4r/√3, but the consistent FCC relation is a = 2√2 r. The stated relation corresponds to BCC geometry, not FCC geometry.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the incorrect formula a = 4r/√3 (which corresponds to BCC geometry) instead of the correct FCC relation a = 2√2 r. It repeats the original error verbatim, deriving r = a√3/4 ≈ 0.177 nm, whereas the correct FCC calculation using a = 2√2 r would give r = 0.408/(2√2) ≈ 0.144 nm.
